stories.title: Configure a suitable menu item
stories.actor_goal: Choose an available menu item with understood dietary and allergen information.
stories.value_outcome: A valid, accurately described item is in the basket.

acceptance_criteria.title: Customer adds an informed valid configuration
acceptance_criteria.context: Published menu items and their current configuration information are available to a customer.
acceptance_criteria.event: The customer browses, filters, configures, and adds an item to the basket.
expected_outcomes: The basket contains only the customer’s allowed, currently available configuration.

The customer can see the applicable product, dietary, allergen, final-configuration, and cross-contact information, including the required gluten-free acknowledgement before that configuration is ordered.
The menu preserves the accepted product ordering and does not reserve an empty image area when a product has no photograph.

stories.title: Consider compatible basket recommendations
stories.actor_goal: Optionally add a relevant compatible item without losing control of the basket.
stories.value_outcome: The basket changes only through the customer’s confirmed choice.

acceptance_criteria.title: Customer accepts or ignores a compatible recommendation
acceptance_criteria.context: A customer has a basket containing an item eligible for configured recommendations.
acceptance_criteria.event: The customer views the recommendations and either adds one or continues checkout.
expected_outcomes: Only currently eligible, compatible recommendations are offered with their ordinary dietary and allergen information.
The customer may add a recommendation or ignore it without automatic basket changes.
Global or source-product disabling prevents recommendations while leaving catalog products available normally.

stories.title: Submit a feasible guest pickup order
stories.actor_goal: Place a pickup order with a feasible commitment.
stories.value_outcome: The customer receives the order outcome and pickup commitment.

acceptance_criteria.title: Customer submits a feasible order
acceptance_criteria.context: A guest customer has a valid basket and checkout is available.
acceptance_criteria.event: The customer begins checkout, provides required contact details, selects a feasible pickup opportunity, and submits.
expected_outcomes: The customer can order as a guest and receives feasible pickup opportunities based on the final basket and current service conditions.
A configured temporary hold protects a checkout in progress and is released when it expires or is abandoned.
A successfully submitted order shows its resulting status and pickup commitment.

acceptance_criteria.title: Customer receives alternatives after failed final revalidation
acceptance_criteria.context: A customer submits a basket whose earlier pickup opportunity is no longer feasible.
acceptance_criteria.event: The final order check detects the changed availability.
expected_outcomes: No confirmed order is created for the unavailable opportunity.
The customer receives the nearest feasible alternatives.

stories.title: Respond to a revised pickup commitment
stories.actor_goal: Respond privately to a material proposed pickup change.
stories.value_outcome: The order reflects the customer’s response or its safe expiry handling.

acceptance_criteria.title: Customer responds within the configured window
acceptance_criteria.context: Private tracking presents a proposed alternative pickup time or material revised estimate.
acceptance_criteria.event: The customer accepts or declines the proposal before the configured response window ends.
expected_outcomes: The response is reflected in the order’s operational handling.
Acceptance preserves the resulting pickup commitment; rejection of a material revised estimate is handled visibly for operations.

acceptance_criteria.title: Unanswered proposal receives safe expiry handling
acceptance_criteria.context: A customer has not responded to a proposed alternative within the configured response window.
acceptance_criteria.event: The response window expires.
expected_outcomes: The customer receives the applicable outcome and the order follows the accepted safe handling rather than silently accepting the change.

stories.title: Register an assisted pickup order
stories.actor_goal: Record a telephone or in-person order in the shared operating flow.
stories.value_outcome: The assisted order joins the ordinary lifecycle with its origin and feasible pickup opportunity.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff records an assisted order
acceptance_criteria.context: An authorised staff member receives a telephone or in-person pickup request.
acceptance_criteria.event: The staff member records the requested order and its feasible pickup opportunity.
expected_outcomes: The order enters the shared order lifecycle and kitchen queue with its origin recorded.
The customer receives the next feasible opportunity without displacing accepted orders.

stories.title: Control online ordering mode
stories.actor_goal: Set the safe online-order admission mode for current conditions.
stories.value_outcome: Online ordering follows the selected permitted mode.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff changes online admission mode
acceptance_criteria.context: An authorised staff member reviews current operating conditions.
acceptance_criteria.event: The staff member selects automatic acceptance, manual review, or paused ordering.
expected_outcomes: Online ordering follows the selected mode.
The selected mode is limited by the accepted pilot and access conditions.

stories.title: Review a pending web order
stories.actor_goal: Resolve a pending web order in manual-review mode.
stories.value_outcome: The customer and operations receive the recorded order decision.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff resolves pending order
acceptance_criteria.context: A web order is pending under manual review.
acceptance_criteria.event: The authorised staff member reviews its feasible pickup opportunity.
expected_outcomes: The staff member may accept, reject, or propose a feasible alternative pickup time.
The recorded decision produces the applicable customer and operational outcome.

stories.title: Revalidate a customer-requested order change
stories.actor_goal: Apply a permitted telephone-requested change safely.
stories.value_outcome: The customer receives the revalidated outcome for the changed order.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff applies a permitted order change
acceptance_criteria.context: A changeable order is the subject of a later customer telephone request.
acceptance_criteria.event: The authorised staff member applies the permitted change.
expected_outcomes: The order is revalidated for the applicable operational consequences.
The customer receives the resulting revalidated outcome.

stories.title: Maintain feasible service capacity
stories.actor_goal: Keep schedule, pickup windows, and capacity aligned with approved service operations.
stories.value_outcome: New order admission reflects the current approved service plan.

acceptance_criteria.title: Jaime maintains normal service plan
acceptance_criteria.context: Jaime is preparing or revising a planned service period.
acceptance_criteria.event: Jaime changes normal operating hours, pickup windows, or capacity.
expected_outcomes: Order workload and admission use the configured service plan, including approved date-specific exceptions.
When nearer capacity is full, the earliest available pickup estimate advances accordingly.

acceptance_criteria.title: Authorised actor makes current-service adjustment
acceptance_criteria.context: A current service needs a permitted temporary adjustment.
acceptance_criteria.event: An authorised actor blocks or reopens a pickup window, or the responsible person applies a temporary delay or capacity reduction.
expected_outcomes: Admission reflects the temporary adjustment.
The adjustment remains bounded to the actor’s authority and current service.

stories.title: Prepare and progress an accepted order
stories.actor_goal: Receive, prepare, and accurately progress an accepted order.
stories.value_outcome: The kitchen and customer have the current observable order status.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff progresses an accepted order to ready
acceptance_criteria.context: An accepted order enters an authorised staff kitchen queue.
acceptance_criteria.event: Staff acknowledge, start preparation, progress, and complete the order.
expected_outcomes: New, scheduled, active, ready, attention, and history work are distinguishable so staff can act on the current operational priority.
Staff can acknowledge and progress only valid order states; preparation start, early start, delay, acknowledgement, and material status remain visible as applicable.
Customer name and pickup time guide work; after an order is ready the customer receives the required notification, and handed-over orders leave the primary work view while remaining in history.

stories.title: Keep saleability aligned with stock
stories.actor_goal: Update stock and availability so new sales remain safe.
stories.value_outcome: Current saleability prevents unavailable configurations from being sold.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff updates product and option saleability
acceptance_criteria.context: An authorised staff member observes a product, option, or stock condition needing action.
acceptance_criteria.event: The staff member records an authorised stock or availability adjustment.
expected_outcomes: All order channels use the same current stock and availability condition, including opening counts, replenishments, corrections, shared critical options, daily limits, and pickup-window limits where configured.
Only affected products or configurations become unavailable; sold-out products remain visible but cannot be ordered, and a valid product remains orderable when only an option is disabled.
The applicable service-day policy and low-stock condition are observable for each product.

stories.title: Maintain approved catalog content
stories.actor_goal: Keep published products and options accurate and approved.
stories.value_outcome: Eligible catalog content is safe and complete for customers.

acceptance_criteria.title: Responsible person publishes approved catalog change
acceptance_criteria.context: A responsible person has reviewed catalog content or product configuration to create or change.
acceptance_criteria.event: The responsible person confirms a complete approved catalog change.
expected_outcomes: The responsible person can maintain authorised product commercial content, availability, ordering, featuring, scheduling, and hiding.
Customer configuration uses defined allowed options for removals, substitutions, and paid extras.
Published products appear in the accepted featured and manual order.

stories.title: Isolate unsafe sale
stories.actor_goal: Stop a safety-affected product or option from further sale.
stories.value_outcome: Affected sales are restricted and accepted affected orders enter review.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff restricts an unsafe product or option
acceptance_criteria.context: Staff detects incorrect safety or dietary information, or gluten-free dough cannot be operated safely.
acceptance_criteria.event: Staff disables the affected product or option and alerts the responsible person.
expected_outcomes: New affected sales stop immediately and the affected scope is paused until resolved.
Accepted undelivered orders using the affected configuration enter operational review with the incident and correction history preserved.
Gluten-free dough can be disabled independently of products that offer it.

stories.title: Track an order privately
stories.actor_goal: See the material status and pickup information for an order privately.
stories.value_outcome: The customer can follow the order without gaining general editing rights.

acceptance_criteria.title: Customer opens private order tracking
acceptance_criteria.context: An order has been submitted and the customer receives its private access message.
acceptance_criteria.event: The customer opens the private tracking view.
expected_outcomes: The customer receives one SMS that provides secure private order tracking access.
The tracking view shows the current material order and pickup status, including every material pickup-estimate revision.

stories.title: Collect payment and hand over order
stories.actor_goal: Complete collection payment and hand over a ready order accurately.
stories.value_outcome: Payment and handover are separately recorded before collection completes.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff completes collection
acceptance_criteria.context: A ready order is collected at the premises.
acceptance_criteria.event: Staff records the actual payment method and hands over the order after successful payment.
expected_outcomes: Cash or card payment is recorded at collection; cash handling supports the tendered amount and change calculation.
Payment and handover remain separate, including an auditable correction when an order is marked handed over in error.
A person identifying the customer name and order number may collect, and the customer can receive a compatible printed receipt.

stories.title: Handle non-collection
stories.actor_goal: Resolve an uncollected order through the accepted operational process.
stories.value_outcome: The order has an authorised non-collection outcome and history.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff resolves non-collection
acceptance_criteria.context: A confirmed pickup window has ended and the order remains uncollected.
acceptance_criteria.event: Staff completes the required contact attempt and authorised non-collection handling.
expected_outcomes: Only after the configured grace conditions may staff mark the order NO_SHOW.
An authorised extension remains within its configured maximum and is recorded in the order’s history.

stories.title: Close an accountable service shift
stories.actor_goal: Complete the required service close review.
stories.value_outcome: Cash review, unresolved matters, and session closure are recorded.

acceptance_criteria.title: Team member closes the shift
acceptance_criteria.context: Service work is ready for close.
acceptance_criteria.event: A current team member reviews open orders, payments, incidents, and cash before confirming close.
expected_outcomes: Expected and actual cash are compared and any difference can be explained.
The close records the reviewer and the required operational review, then closes responsible sessions.

stories.title: Resolve an operational incident
stories.actor_goal: Apply a safe customer and operational resolution to an exception.
stories.value_outcome: The incident has a traceable resolution or escalation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Staff resolves or escalates an incident
acceptance_criteria.context: An order, contact, delay, shortage, payment, or fulfilment exception needs staff action.
acceptance_criteria.event: Staff reviews the visible attention work and records an authorised resolution.
expected_outcomes: Staff can contact the customer, resolve the incident, cancel an order with its reason, or route an unfulfillable accepted order for attention without silent cancellation.
Any allowed substitution follows defined relationships or fallback rules, and authorised responsible people can reopen a wrongly resolved incident while retaining its history.

stories.title: Handle a pending Jaime decision
stories.actor_goal: Resolve a staff-escalated decision outside routine authority.
stories.value_outcome: The pending decision remains visible until Jaime records its resolution.

acceptance_criteria.title: Jaime resolves visible pending decision
acceptance_criteria.context: Staff has recorded a decision that exceeds authorised rules and a safe interim measure.
acceptance_criteria.event: Jaime reviews the pending decision at opening or in the next report.
expected_outcomes: The pending decision preserves its related matter, safe measure, responsible lead, review state, and resolution.
Open decisions are visible for Jaime’s next operational review.

stories.title: Open accountable service
stories.actor_goal: Assume recorded responsibility before online ordering opens.
stories.value_outcome: Online ordering is open only under an identified authorised responsible person.

acceptance_criteria.title: Responsible person opens service
acceptance_criteria.context: A service is ready to begin and an authorised responsible person is present.
acceptance_criteria.event: The responsible person assumes and records service responsibility.
expected_outcomes: Online ordering cannot open until Jaime or the currently authorised delegate has assumed responsibility.
The resulting responsibility record supports safe operation in the configured ordering mode.

stories.title: Manage staff access and delegation
stories.actor_goal: Keep staff operational access and delegation current and bounded.
stories.value_outcome: Access reflects Jaime’s current authorisations and review.

acceptance_criteria.title: Jaime maintains current staff access
acceptance_criteria.context: Jaime is authorising, reviewing, revoking, or changing staff access.
acceptance_criteria.event: Jaime records the relevant staff access decision.
expected_outcomes: Only Jaime changes staff permissions.
Temporary staff and shared operational sessions remain bounded away from sensitive administration.
Departing access is removed before the next service, and Jaime can review active access before the pilot and personnel changes.

stories.title: Review controlled operational reports
stories.actor_goal: Review defined operational and pilot evidence.
stories.value_outcome: The responsible person can evaluate service performance from controlled evidence.

acceptance_criteria.title: Responsible person reviews weekly service evidence
acceptance_criteria.context: Authorised operational report information is available for review.
acceptance_criteria.event: The responsible person opens the service report.
expected_outcomes: The report covers the defined channel, peak, incident, delay, performance, value, and product-combination evidence.
On-time performance and manual capacity overrides are visible for review.

stories.title: Prepare and operate a controlled pilot
stories.actor_goal: Run the pilot only under its approved safeguards and learn from its evidence.
stories.value_outcome: Pilot activity follows its approved controls and produces the required evidence.

acceptance_criteria.title: Responsible person runs controlled pilot activity
acceptance_criteria.context: Pilot prerequisites, approved safeguards, and responsible staff are in place.
acceptance_criteria.event: The responsible person starts, monitors, pauses when required, and evaluates the controlled pilot.
expected_outcomes: Pilot evidence includes the required pre-pilot channel baseline and rehearsal, and the first real session follows the accepted limited controlled conditions.
Critical pilot conditions pause the affected scope safely.
After four complete weeks, the pilot is evaluated against the defined reliability, adoption, operational-value, performance, and progression evidence.
